rule: Sam, 2026-11-17, relayed by COBIx on #3358 section 2: collect with gaps noted and confidence scores; Commons Clarity's Part B (#3480, comment 6967374303); COBIx's D2 decision (major total differs, about 30); Sam's routine prompt of 2026-11-25, as the S739 conductor's brief carries it: a record held for a gap is collected with its gap named and a lower score on the 0-100 bar, never held, unless the record is not the program's own; S739: San Jose City's records kb/receipts/program_requirement_records_piles_s739_san_jose_city_2026-11-26_s740c4.json held, read again by key: passed by a rescore where today's scorer's one reading moves them, else collected with their gaps named where the record is the program's own (no reread, no reconcile)

gaps.required_list_outside_total: The catalog prints a list the program requires apart from its printed total, and the record counts that list; without it the courses add to the printed total.
gaps.total_differs: The catalog prints a total for this program that its own printed units do not add to.

records.words: The Approved Program Electives block lies outside the 31-32 unit major total; its minimum of 2 is taken from the 'AS Degree Requirements' table ('Approved Program Electives 2'), which is also recorded in degree_elective_units. The heading itself says 'as needed to reach 60 units' but the page prints 2 units, so electives_fill_degree is false.

program.section_heading: Medical Assisting: Clinical - Associate in Science
outcomes: Apply principles of anatomy/physiology and medical terminology to clinical protocols and procedures.
Execute the clinical skills required of a medical assistant.
Exercise compliance with regard to HIPAA and OSHA regulations, and be able to explain relevant privacy and safety protocols to patients and other health professionals.
Apply knowledge of clinical medical assisting to passing the Certified Medical Assistant (CMA) exam and/or the Registered Medical Assisting (RMA) exam.
Communicate effectively with patients and other health care personnel while exercising the highest level of professional conduct.

Utilize the practical experience acquired during a clinical externship performed in a doctor's office, clinic, hospital, or laboratory to successfully integrate into a similar clinical health care environment upon post-graduate employment.
Service the community by filling a need for qualified, well-trained clinical medical assistants.

Complete one of the following courses:
Approved Program Electives (as needed to reach 60 units)

before_image.award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Construction technology: Residential Maintenance - Certificate of Achievement Level 2
outcomes: Demonstrate appropriate use of construction tools, methods and materials, follow safety practices and procedures used in the industry.
Demonstrate understanding of construction terms, concepts, and hands-on applications.
Read and interpret building codes, blueprints, manuals, specifications, shop drawings.
Apply effective use of emerging technologies in the construction trades including application Virtual Design and Construction (VDC) and energy efficiency.

representation: checks.gaps and checks.confidence added as the load reads the filed score (a passing row: checks.arithmetic to equal); checks.coverage, invented and the record unchanged
claim_check_reads: Today's capture (sources.json): every course an entry names among the codes it found, and a course an entry says the printed total leaves out on neither it nor the state's list. A note's quoted figures are the reader's words, never re-read here.
follow_verdict: The follow_verdict trigger marks a row checked when its latest verdict is a confirm whose fingerprint matches the record and the machine checks pass. The record is unchanged here, so such a confirm on a row this plan moves to passing would check it at the apply, and the rollback would skip it. The pre-read counts those rows (confirm_matches); the apply aborts, writing nothing, unless the count is 0.
